_note: Verified facts the answers may use. Wording is hedged on purpose ('usually', 'check in your app'). Checked against the live help pages on 8 Nov 2026.

failure_reasons.text: Groww lists three usual reasons an instalment fails: AutoPay is not set up, there wasn't enough balance in the bank account, or the SIP is linked to an AutoPay that isn't approved yet.

balance_lead_days.text: Keep enough balance in your bank account 4 days before the SIP date so AutoPay can go through.

pay_now_window.text: If a SIP fails because of low balance, a 'Pay Now' option usually appears on the mutual fund dashboard for 2 working days.

pay_one_time_route.text: You can pay for the month yourself: Mutual Funds → SIPs → choose the SIP → 'Pay one-time' → enter the SIP amount → complete the payment.

nav_on_completion.text: The NAV used is the one for when the payment completes, not the original SIP date.

some_funds_no_one_time.text: Some funds don't accept one-time investments, so the one-time option may not show for every SIP.

pending_past_date_failed.text: If a pending SIP isn't paid by the date shown on it, that instalment is treated as failed.

no_platform_charge.text: Groww doesn't charge anything for a failed SIP order.

bank_bounce_fee.text: Your bank may charge a bounce (ECS/NACH rejection) fee when a debit fails for low balance. The amount varies by bank; your bank can tell you what it charged and why.

one_miss_not_cancel.text: One failed instalment doesn't cancel your SIP. Your next instalment is set up as usual.

three_in_row.text: Generally, 3 failed instalments in a row can lead to the SIP being cancelled. Check in your app for how your SIP is treated.

cancel_keeps_investment.text: Cancelling a SIP only stops future instalments. The money you’ve already invested stays invested until you choose to withdraw it.

skip_next_short.text: Skip the next instalment: Groww lets you skip one at a time. Your SIP stays set up, and what you’ve already invested stays invested.

edit_amount_date.text: Mutual Funds → SIPs → choose the SIP → Edit SIP or Change Amount/Date (the button name can vary by app version) to change the amount and/or date (check in your app). The change applies from the next SIP payment date.

skip_path.text: Mutual Funds → SIPs → choose the SIP → Edit SIP → Skip instalment (check in your app).

edit_within_2_working_days.text: If your next instalment is within 2 working days, a skip or change will apply from the one after.

three_skips_cancel.text: Skipping three instalments in a row cancels the SIP automatically, so skip only the months you need to.

cancel_notes.text: A cancellation can’t be undone, and you can’t cancel if the next instalment is due within 7 days. To invest again later, you’d start a new SIP.

cancel_path.text: Mutual Funds → SIPs → choose the SIP → Cancel SIP.
